convention: yaw = camera azimuth around the character, degrees. 0 = camera in front (she faces the viewer); +90 = camera at HER LEFT side (she faces screen-left); 180 = back; -90 = camera at her right (she faces screen-right). Same convention as swordswoman/v2/hy3d/inputsD (2mv 'left' = she faces screen-left). Orthographic-ish, camera at mid-height, elevation 0.
framing: body views: same scale, body height = 0.86 of canvas, feet baseline y = 0.93 (from top), x centred on the feet band. head views: shared scale within the head group, baseline y = 0.93.

fl34.yaw_note: mirror of fr34 (design ~symmetric), nominal +45, actual ~40 deg by eye

notes: front/left/back/right from one 4-view turnaround call. Alt single front: raw/schoolgirl_front_a.png. White blouse: matte = union of flood fill (min RGB>=248) and rembg.
